attribution.derived_from: Exact names, descriptions and inputSchema objects of ten shipped snapshot_tools() descriptors; not live tools/list
attribution.redistribution_basis: Observed declared-commit MIT LICENSE and package declaration, with byte-identical descriptor-source Python module; full upstream notice carried in linked documentation

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Read-only ranked search over the selected brain's knowledge base — returns the top matching document or chunk rows, never writes. Scope: the optional `brain_id`, otherwise BRAIN_ID or the nearest project `.brain/config.json`; with no project brain it soft-fails with guidance rather than erroring the session. No approval needed — it only reads. Trust: every hit carries a citation (file + heading) and a per-hit confidence, plus an overall confidence for the result set and its coverage verdict (gapDetected, uncovered, suggestedAction; uncovered=true means the hits are about something else, however high they score), in the text and in structuredContent. It never escalates on its own: a weak verdict comes back as it is, with a `hint` that points at `knowledge_ask`. Reversible by nature: a read changes nothing.

brain_id.description: Brain to search; defaults to BRAIN_ID or the nearest .brain/config.json from the caller-provided project working directory (or the MCP process working directory when absent).

tools.name: brain_remember
tools.description: Native brain memory (core tier), backed by brain's own Postgres substrate — at parity with the mnemosyne organ's `mnemosyne_remember`. Contract: [write] · scope=brain · approval=silent-ok · reversibility=reversible. Not recall-class: results carry no citations.

scope.description: Memory scope. New memory: defaults to "session". Existing memory (same content): changed only when supplied.

importance.description: 0-1. New memory: defaults to 0.5. Existing memory: changed only when supplied.

source.description: Provenance label. New memory: defaults to "user". Existing memory: changed only when supplied.

veracity.description: New memory: defaults to "unknown". Existing memory: changed only when supplied.

valid_until.description: Expiry date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Omit or "" for none; an existing expiry is changed only when a date is supplied.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata object. New memory: defaults to {}. Existing memory: replaced only when supplied.

session_id.description: Session correlation id. Existing memory: changed only when supplied.
